task_title: Skip barrier lookup closures when the registry is empty

plan_review.notes: Reviewer was asked to red-team shape (c) (live-size gate) and argue for (a) closure-internal check or (b) cached presence flag instead. It upheld (c): (a) still pays ~34M closure invocations, (b) is a staleness hazard. Verdict SHIP WITH CHANGES with 3 required changes: (1) use two separate presence fields so neither setter clobbers the other (already caught and fixed before the review returned); (2) expand regression coverage to independent ring-only/tile-only/drop/reassignment/custom-callback cases; (3) prove a stable win for the exact live-size implementation before shipping. All 3 done. Reviewer independently confirmed the emptiness equivalence with file:line and found no concrete staleness scenario.
